footnote_text: Upon termination of the Bruce Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Bruce Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed all 1,372,521 shares of common stock it held. Of those shares, 856,598 were distributed to the Bruce Leeds Declaration of Trust and continue to be reported as indirectly owned by the reporting person. The remaining 515,923 shares were distributed to the Bruce Leeds 2008 Family Trust.

Upon termination of the Richard Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Richard Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed 330,192 shares of common stock to the Richard Leeds 2008 Family Trust. The reporting person serves as a co-trustee and disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.

Upon termination of the Robert Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Robert Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed 227,007 shares of common stock to the Robert Leeds 2008 Family Trust. The reporting person serves as a co-trustee and disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
